title: Alpine Recreation Center – Expansion (Aka Alpine Recreation Center Expansion
text:
Alpine Recreation Center – Expansion (Aka Alpine Recreation Center Expansion
  Linkage) (PRJ21877) (W.O.#E1908556) Project – Approval of Final Plans and
  Specifications – Categorical Exemption from the Provisions of the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19, Section 15311(a) [On-
  Premises Signs] of California CEQA Guidelines and Article III, Section 1, Class
  11(1) and Class 11(6) of City CEQA Guidelines
summary: Approval of final plans and specifications for Alpine Recreation Center expansion with categorical exemption from CEQA.
